newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken says share buy back price 155 skr/shr.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken says share buy back price 155 skr/shr.

text.p: Swedish state-controlled bank Nordbanken AB said on Friday the price for its share buy back had been set at 155 crowns per share.
The bank also said private shareholders who no longer wanted to sell back their shares but had already sent in their applications could change their minds.

"The price development of the Nordbanken share since it announced the buy back has been very strong. The day before the bank announced the buy back, the share traded at 135.50 crowns," Nordbanken said in a statement.

"Because of the difference in the buy back share price and the current market price, Nordbanken has decided that those shareholders, other than the state, can recall their applications if they would like to do so," it said.
Nordbanken said in September it planned to buy back five billion crowns worth of shares, reducing the government's ownership in the bank to 58 percent from 65.5 percent.
Nordbanken closed on Friday at 175 crowns.
